In this Flutter repo (cerne-ciclo-b), I need to understand how "logout"/sign-out is currently implemented, and how the app's SessionRepository and AuthRepository relate, so I can figure out whether adding a "usar e-mail e senha" link on the vault-lock screen (lib/features/vault/presentation/screens/vault_lock_screen.dart) can realistically navigate to the /auth (login) screen.

Context: `core/navigation/app_router.dart`'s `_redirect` function enforces that whenever `VaultRepository.currentStatus != VaultStatus.unlocked`, ANY navigation attempt gets redirected back to `/vault` (AD-14 — the vault gate is checked before session status and overrides every other location). So simply calling `context.go('/auth')` from the vault lock screen would be immediately bounced back to `/vault` by this redirect, since the vault is still locked at that point.

Please investigate and report back (don't write any code, just research):
1. Is there anywhere in the codebase (account settings "Sair" action, or elsewhere) an existing "logout" / sign-out call chain? Find the file(s) and the repository method(s) involved (e.g. `AuthRepository.logout()`, `SessionRepository` methods). Give exact file paths and line numbers.
2. Is there any existing way to flip `VaultRepository.currentStatus` back to something other than `unlocked`, or any "lock the vault again" / "reset vault" method on `VaultRepository` or its implementation? Check `lib/features/vault/domain/repositories/vault_repository.dart` and `lib/features/vault/data/repositories/vault_repository_impl.dart`.
3. Does `docs/input/requirements.md` or `docs/input/backend/` say anything about what should happen when a user wants to abandon the on-device biometric/PIN vault and re-authenticate with email+password instead (e.g., forgotten PIN, switching accounts)? Search for related terms.
4. Is there any `_bmad-output/implementation-artifacts/` planning doc (deferred-work.md, sprint-status.yaml, or any spec-2-*.md files) that mentions the "usar e-mail e senha" link, Tela 0.1, or deferring this link's functionality to a later story?

Report concisely (under 400 words) with file:line references for each finding, and your best read on whether there is an already-existing, safe way to make this link functionally navigate to /auth, or whether this would require adding new repository functionality that doesn't exist yet.
